title: From Location Phrases to Geographic Entities: Task-Adapted Retrieval for People Search
abstract: arXiv:2608.28965v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: People search must map free-form location phrases to geographic entities used as structured retrieval filters. Lexical standardizers handle canonical names well but are brittle to aliases, misspellings, metropolitan expressions, and same-name ambiguity. We formulate this task as graded, set-valued entity retrieval over a fixed ontology. We identify three coupled design requirements: distinguishing identity-preserving variation from knowledge-dependent aliases, controlling false negatives among valid same-name entities, and separating stable transformations from mutable entity knowledge. We realize them in a prompt-asymmetric bi-encoder with calibrated alias support, bounded ambiguity-aware negatives, and editable entity documents that support localized updates without retraining. translated_title: 从位置短语到地理实体：面向人员搜索的任务自适应检索
translated_abstract: 人员搜索系统需要将自由格式的位置短语映射为用作结构化检索过滤条件的地理实体。基于词汇的标准化方法能够很好地处理规范名称，但在面对别名、拼写错误、大都市圈表达方式以及同名歧义时十分脆弱。我们将该任务形式化为在固定本体上进行的分级、集合值实体检索。我们识别出三个相互耦合的设计需求：区分保持身份一致性的变体与依赖知识的别名、控制有效同名实体之间的假阴性、以及将稳定的变换与可变的实体知识相分离。我们通过一个提示非对称的双编码器实现了这些需求，该编码器具备经过校准的别名支持、有界的歧义感知负样本采样，以及支持无需重新训练即可进行局部更新的可编辑实体文档。在一个固定的生产环境衍生的开发基准和一个公开的GeoNames迁移任务上，任务自适应方法相较于冻结编码器取得了显著提升……
tldr: 该论文将人员搜索中位置短语到地理实体的映射形式化为固定本体上的分级集合值实体检索，并提出具备校准别名支持、歧义感知负样本和可编辑实体文档的提示非对称双编码器，性能显著优于冻结编码器。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates mapping free-form location phrases to geographic entities in people search as graded set-valued entity retrieval over a fixed ontology, proposing a prompt-asymmetric bi-encoder with calibrated alias support, ambiguity-aware negatives, and editable entity documents that substantially outperforms frozen encoders.
